preconditions.description: The size of the array a is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The number of queries is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
Each element of the array a is at least 1 and at most 10^5.
The subarray indices l and r are within the bounds of the array.
The number of distinct integers k is at least 1 and at most 10^5.

postconditions.description: The output value is -1 if it is impossible to choose k distinct integers, or a positive integer dif otherwise.
